Verdict written to `page/footer/iter-04/verdict.json`.

**Scores: desktop 96, tablet 94, mobile 93 - overall 93.**

Evidence behind the call:

- **Desktop is effectively a pixel match.** Panel v-extent 0-239 and h-extent 12-1427 identical to the reference; wash sampled rgb(240,232,229) vs ref rgb(240,233,229); no stroke, as the spec requires. All nine backer logos sit in the same 51-77px band with x-runs matching within 1px, and the darken blend at 0.6 reads correctly (no white plates). Meta row: copyright x50-224/y152-160 vs ref y152-161, hairline rule present between copyright and email, email correctly not uppercased, wordmark box 642-797 vs 642-798. Social icons are the only measurable drift, ~2px left.
- **Pixel diff (2.33% mismatch) is mostly noise**: text antialiasing plus a red "5 Issues" dev-server overlay badge sitting over the bottom-left of the panel in every screenshot. That badge is tooling, not section markup, so I logged it non-actionable.
- **Tablet/mobile have no mock**, so I judged them structurally: backers wrap 5+4 at 768 and 3-per-row at 390, panel height grows, meta row goes static then becomes a centred column (wordmark → copyright/rule/email → socials) - exactly the spec's responsive intent. No overflow, no clipped or lost content.
- **Nothing critical or warning-level survived.** The only actionable notes are info-grade: the 2px social-row offset and social icon tap targets under ~44px on touch widths.

No project files were touched.
